common.notConfigured: Accounts are being set up. Please try again later or contact us on WhatsApp.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.purpose: One account saves your test, your results and your training. It takes about two minutes.
signUp.help: Your details stay private. We use them only to run your training and to contact you about it.
signUp.fullNamePlaceholder: As it appears on your ID
signUp.fullNameWhy: We put this name on your results and certificates.
signUp.emailWhy: You sign in with it, and we send your results and receipts there.
signUp.passwordWhy: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
signUp.phoneHint: Qatar mobile, or an international number starting with +
signUp.phoneWhy: So we can reach you on WhatsApp if your test needs attention.
signUp.institutionOther: Name of your school, university or company
signUp.institutionWhy: It helps us plan training sessions near you and for your school.
signUp.studyLevelWhy: We match examples and pace to where you are in your studies.
signUp.dateOfBirthWhy: Competitions have age rules, and anyone under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's consent.
signUp.minorBody: Because you are under 18, we need a parent or guardian's consent. Please add their details below and tick the box with them.
signUp.guardianPhoneWhy: We contact them only about your account, your training or payments.
signUp.guardianConsent: My parent or guardian agrees that I create this account and take part in CAD Champions.
signUp.cadSoftwareWhy: We suggest the training track that fits the software you already know.
signUp.cadExperience: How long have you used CAD?
signUp.cadExperienceWhy: We start your training at the right level.
signUp.computerWhy: Inventor runs on Windows only. If you have a Mac, we suggest Fusion.
signUp.marketing: Send me news about competitions, training dates and offers. You can stop any time.
signUp.legal: By creating an account you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
signUp.fixErrorsBody: Some answers are missing or need a change. Each field says what to fix.
signUp.completePurpose: You are signed in. Add a few details so we can set up your training.
signUp.successBody: Welcome to CAD Champions. Let's set up your training.

institution.udst: University of Doha for Science and Technology (UDST, formerly CNA-Q)

errors.tooLong: This is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter a full email address, like name@example.com.
errors.passwordRules: Use at least 8 characters with at least one number.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter a mobile number we can reach on WhatsApp, for example +974 5512 3478.
errors.dobFuture: That date is in the future. Please check it.
errors.dobRange: Please check the year of your date of birth.
errors.guardianName: Add your parent's or guardian's name.
errors.guardianConsent: Your parent or guardian needs to agree before you can continue.
errors.institutionOther: Type the name of your school, university or company.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right. Check both and try again, or reset your password.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. We can send the confirmation email again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
errors.rateLimitedNoTime: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead, or reset your password.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Please choose a stronger one.
errors.captcha: We couldn't confirm you're not a robot. Please complete the check again.
errors.captchaRequired: Please complete the check above first.
errors.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
errors.samePassword: Your new password must be different from the old one.
errors.network: We couldn't reach our server. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment.
errors.profileSave: We couldn't save your details. Please try again, or contact us if it keeps happening.
errors.signedOut: You were signed out. Please sign in again.
errors.notConfigured: Accounts are being set up. Please try again later.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.purpose: We sent you a link to confirm your email address. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.steps: Open the email from Gestaltung and press the button. The link opens your account here.
checkEmail.spam: Can't find it? Look in your spam or junk folder. It can take a few minutes to arrive.
checkEmail.resentBody: Check your inbox in a minute.
checkEmail.already: If you already had an account with this email, you can sign in instead.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.purpose: Sign in to continue your training and see your results.
signIn.magicHelp: No password needed: we email you a link that signs you in.
signIn.magicSentBody: If there is an account for this address, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it on this device.
signIn.linkExpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Sign in below or ask for a new link.
signIn.resendConfirmDone: Confirmation email sent. Check your inbox and spam folder.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.purpose: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If there is an account for this address, we sent a link to reset your password. It works once and expires soon.
forgot.expired: That reset link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.purpose: Type your new password. You stay signed in on this device.
reset.doneBody: Your new password is saved. Use it next time you sign in.
reset.noSessionBody: Reset links work once and expire after a while. Ask for a new one and open it on this device.

denied.title: You don't have access to that page
denied.body: It is for staff only. If you think this is a mistake, contact us.
